data.name: Verdict of Exile
data.description: While using judgment, you can unleash the verdict of exile on a creature. When you do, your judgment ends, but the creature subject to that judgment is dazed for 1 round (Will DC %1 negates); if the creature is possessed or an outsider, the possessing entity or outsider is affected by dismissal (Will negates).|VerdictOfExileDC
